title: My Sister-In-Law Forged My Name, Sold Our $1.1M Mortuary, Mailed Me $5K. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 29 years as a cafeteria manager, I put $158,000 from my 401(k) into a mortuary with my sister-in-law. She forged a shareholder resolution, sold the business for $1.1 million, and mailed me a $5,000 casket check. I proved the backdating with email metadata, voided the sale, and now she waxes hearses at Rigor of Deceit Mortuary. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #MortuaryJustice
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MY NAME AND SOLD MY MORTUARY
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law took your $158,000 retirement, forged a shareholder resolution, and mailed you a $5,000 casket check after selling the mortuary for $1.1 million, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.
